messages.content: Camden Riverhouse just emailed me. The room we booked has one queen and they will not allow three people in it, even though the search accepted all three of us. They can move us to two queens, and I have two other options. Compare everything and fix this before we lose the cancellation window.

Send me the quoted totals and room details for the Riverhouse replacement and both alternatives. I also need each property's parking terms, location, cancellation deadline, and whether the room itself is approved for three guests.

Riverhouse: two queen beds, five nights for $1,948.40, free parking, downtown Camden, and confirmed occupancy of four. Lord Camden Inn: two queens, $2,106.20, downtown, $20 nightly valet, occupancy four. Hampton Inn Rockland: two queens, $1,548.75, free parking, occupancy four, about 15 minutes from Camden. Those are full room totals, but check whether parking is already included in the comparison.

On a five-night basis, Riverhouse remains $1,948.40 because parking is included. Lord Camden reaches $2,206.20 after five valet nights. Hampton Rockland remains $1,548.75 with included parking. Hampton is $399.65 less than Riverhouse and $657.45 less than Lord Camden. Riverhouse and Lord Camden are both walkable to central Camden; Hampton requires driving for Camden meals and outings. All three have two queen beds and explicitly accept three guests.
What about breakfast and the cancellation terms? For a five-night family stay, included breakfast would make the mornings easier, so prioritize that if the rest of the choice is close.

Riverhouse confirms continental breakfast for all three guests in the quoted rate. Hampton Rockland also includes breakfast for all registered guests. Lord Camden's quote is room-only; breakfast is available separately. Riverhouse is cancellable with deposit recovery until 6:00 p.m. Eastern on July 3. Hampton is cancellable until 11:59 p.m. Eastern on July 11. Lord Camden requires cancellation by 3:00 p.m. Eastern on June 29.
So Lord Camden is out. Between the other two, is staying downtown worth the extra $399.65?

For this itinerary, yes. Riverhouse keeps the five-night coastal block centered in Camden, avoids repeated drives and parking searches, and preserves the included breakfast and two-queen setup. Hampton is the value choice, but moving to Rockland changes the trip structure you selected. The tradeoff is $79.93 per night for the downtown location. Riverhouse does impose the earlier July 3 decision deadline.
Can they amend the existing reservation, or does this require canceling and making a new one? I do not want a gap where neither room is secured.

They can amend confirmation CRH-813502 directly. The property will replace the one-queen room with the two-queen room while retaining the reservation dates, so there is no cancellation-and-rebooking gap. The revised total is $1,948.40, which is $250.00 more than the original booking.
Will the original deposit carry over, and what is due now?

The original $339.68 deposit carries over. Riverhouse requires another $50.00 when the amendment is processed, bringing the deposit to $389.68. The remaining $1,558.72 is due at the property. The amended reservation adopts the new cancellation deadline of 6:00 p.m. Eastern July 3; canceling by then returns the full $389.68 deposit.
Make the Riverhouse change. Before you confirm, make sure the reservation names Marcus Lee, Daniel Lee, and Owen Lee as the three guests and says two queen beds, not just occupancy four.

The amendment is ready with all three guests listed and the room description stated as two queen beds. Dates remain July 13 through July 18, and the room is explicitly approved for three occupants. The total is $1,948.40, with a $50.00 additional charge now and $1,558.72 due at the property. Shall I submit it?

The Camden reservation has been amended under the existing confirmation CRH-813502. It now lists Marcus Lee, Daniel Lee, and Owen Lee in a two-queen room for July 13-18, explicitly accommodating three guests. The five-night total is $1,948.40 including parking and breakfast. The original $339.68 deposit transferred, an additional $50.00 was charged, and $1,558.72 remains due at the property. Cancellation with full deposit recovery is available through 6:00 p.m. Eastern July 3. This increases the confirmed reservations total by $250.00 to $5,048.92 including the $50 toll estimate, before fuel, food, and activities.
